title.zh: 将北伊罗戈省巴塔克市镇纳拉辛村的名称变更为将军Artemio Ricarte村的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio Nalasin in the Municipality of Batac, Province of Ilocos Norte, to General Artemio Ricarte
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio Nalasin in the Municipality of Batac, Province of Ilocos Norte, to General Artemio Ricarte
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio Nalasin tại Thị trấn Batac, Tỉnh Ilocos Norte thành General Artemio Ricarte
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ Nalasin ในเทศบาล Batac, จังหวัด Ilocos Norte เป็น General Artemio Ricarte
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio Nalasin di Kotamadya Batac, Provinsi Ilocos Norte menjadi General Artemio Ricarte
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio Nalasin di Perbandaran Batac, Wilayah Ilocos Norte menjadi General Artemio Ricarte

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1968/ra_5287_1968.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Barrio Nalasin in the Municipality of Batac, Province of Ilocos Norte, is hereby changed to General Artemio Ricarte.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
